subject: MAP & deployment decision: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private — CareAble
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@careable.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Evan Lee <evan.lee@careable.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff: deployment mode + region decision (next steps)

Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the deployment-mode decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and the evaluation milestones we think will get CareAble to a production decision by the end of Q1. High level ask from your side: confirm which deployment constraints matter most (data residency, KMS/HSM, audit log retention, procurement timing) and confirm the procurement/contact who will own the paperwork.

Top-line MAP milestones (summary):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize deployment mode preference + region (us-west-2 / us-east-1)
- Week 1: technical deep-dive (networking, KMS, egress controls) + environment access for eval
- Weeks 2–3: 2-week pilot (smoke queries, latency & cost baselines, security checklist)
- Week 4: decision meeting + procurement next steps (purchase order or contract redlines)

Questions for you today:
1) Any hard no's on Hosted (e.g., must be on-prem / private)?
2) Region preference — do you have a strict need for east vs west?
3) Who is handling procurement (email/contact)?

Attachments: CareAble_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

I’ve cc'd Neha (our sales lead) and Evan (IT) to keep technical and procurement threads aligned. Marcus (SE) will join the deep-dive once we lock a slot.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: CareAble_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@careable.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Lee <evan.lee@careable.com>, procurement@careable.com
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: deployment mode + region decision (next steps)

Rachel —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick responses:
- We have a strong preference for Dedicated if it hits our security box; Private (on-prem) is possible but would require a longer lead time and sign-off from our compliance team. Hosted would be preferred only if we can guarantee data residency and KMS controls.
- Region: prefer us-east-1 for reduced latency to our primary cluster, but we can accommodate a west region if there are capacity or cost incentives.
- Procurement: please loop in procurement@careable.com (they're cc'd). PO process usually takes ~3 weeks.

Can you send a quick delta on cost and timeline between Dedicated and Private? Also, is there any prebuilt SOC2 evidence we can review before a pilot?

Thanks —
Tom Hayes
Head of Engineering | CareAble Inc.
Tom.Hayes@careable.com | +1 617-555-0124

Tom / procurement team —

Thanks for the quick reply and the preferences — that helps a lot. I’ve attached a short cost delta (redwood_estimate_dedicated_vs_private.pdf) and an updated MAP worksheet. Highlights below:

Summary of cost & timeline deltas (approx):
- Dedicated (Redwood-managed, reserved pool): 3–4 week lead to provision in us-east-1, expected unit cost ~ $0.022/token (pilot config), standard KMS integration and audit logging included.
- Private (customer VPC / on-prem): 6–10 week onboarding depending on network & HSM schedule, one-time integration engineering effort, lower steady-state unit cost but higher ops lead-time.
- Hosted (SaaS): fastest onboarding (48–72 hrs) but limited options for HSM unless mediated via customer-managed KMS and a contract addendum.

Proposed concrete timeline (if you confirm Dedicated / us-east-1):
- Mon Feb 9: Technical deep-dive (Marcus to lead) — 60m
- Feb 10–24: Pilot (two weeks) — baseline tests, performance/cost measurement
- Week of Feb 23: Decision meeting + PO initiation

Pre-SOC2 evidence: we can share our SOC2 Type II summary and an audit binder during the deep-dive — pulling that today.

Next steps for procurement: if procurement@careable.com can confirm the preferred contract track (PO vs SOW) and a billing contact, we’ll surface an estimated PO-ready quote.

Attaching: redwood_estimate_dedicated_vs_private.pdf and updated CareAble_MAP_v1.xlsx

Thanks —
Rachel Kim

Tom / team —

Thanks — I scheduled the technical deep-dive for Mon Feb 9 at 10:00am ET (calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/meetings/tech-deep-dive-careable). Agenda: networking / VPC peering options, KMS integration patterns (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed), sample latency runs, and pilot success criteria. Please share a minimal list of IP/CIDR ranges we should expect for allowlisting.

A few notes in advance:
- Private (on-prem) rollout typically needs dedicated engineering time to validate HSM/KMS connectivity and our build-nightly for air-gapped installs — estimate 6–10 weeks.
- Dedicated can be spun in faster if procurement is ready for a reserved-capacity commitment; we estimate 3–4 weeks to have a pilot in us-east-1.
- For the pilot, we recommend a 2-week traffic window with the following success criteria: 99th percentile latency < 200ms, token-cost variance < 15% vs estimate, and no unresolved P1 security items.

I’ll bring a draft test plan to the call and follow up with a short runbook that CareAble can use for the pilot. Monica (our customer success lead) will coordinate the PO and billing track once procurement signals the route.

Regards —
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
